# Bookstore Orders API

## Operations

- [list_orders](operations/list-orders.md): List orders, optionally narrowed to one stock status.
- [create_order](operations/create-order.md): Place a new order.
- [create_order_raw](operations/create-order-raw.md): Place an order from a raw, unvalidated payload.
- [get_order](operations/get-order.md): Fetch one order by its identifier.

## Schemas

- [Availability](schemas/availability.md)
- [OrderConfirmation](schemas/order-confirmation.md)
- [OrderInput](schemas/order-input.md)
- [Price](schemas/price.md)
